systems.system: Digitization of civil status registers, Grand-Bassam pilot
systems.tiers: Grand-Bassam town hall: a 16-day pilot digitized over 200,000 records (185,056 births, 5,943 marriages, 14,404 deaths), handed to the mayor on 8 April 2024; extension to the whole country intended, 'with nearly 250 civil status centers already open'

note: Back-capture of registers already written (class archive), with remote ordering of certificates as the next step; the article does not say how Grand-Bassam or any other centre records a new birth or death.
